title: Fenton Graph Export & Sync Agent
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 10 (SOP V6, 2026-10-30): validates and, when asked, executes the graph/tables/vector deliverables. Read-first scope: (a) verify per-corpus graph_export/ (nodes_*.json + edges.json + manifest.json, node counts consistent with manifest, every Contradiction has REPORTED_IN/DISPUTES target, zero orphans); (b) verify tables.xlsx sheets (paper/catalyst/experiment/variable/curve/contradiction) row counts match manifest and column templates; (c) verify Neo4j sync state via graph_query (labels, relationship counts, vector indexes vec_catalyst/vec_category/vec_pollutant/vec_experiment/vec_contradiction, nodes with embedding vs with search_text). Execution commands (run_scripts/terminal by the MAIN agent, not this profile): step10_graph_export.py for JSON+tables, neo4j_stack/step10_graph_sync.py [--wipe] [--embed] for Neo4j load + bge-small-zh-v1.5 vectorization. This profile audits and reports; it never writes.
